description: Returns one wager by its wager id: status, long or short position, shares held, cost basis, ROI, what it pays if it wins (`amount_on_win`), what it would sell for now (`amount_on_sell`), the `market` and `event` it belongs to, and the `actions` history of purchases, sales and resolution. Use it to inspect a position or to check the result after a sale. `event.order_book_enabled` tells you how the position can be sold; see sell_bet. Get wager ids from get_user_bets.

id.description: Wager id, as returned by get_user_bets (field `id`). This is not a market id or an event id.

name: get_wager_details
title: Get wager details
